A year's tuition bill in the USA (2026-27)

Carnegie Mellon: $69,702 (private; tuition, fees separate)
UC Irvine: $59,375 (out-of-state, fall 2026 entry, with insurance)
UCLA: $55,700 (out-of-state, total with surcharge and fees)
Maryland College Park: $44,086 (out-of-state, tuition and fees)

The out-of-state rate also applies to international students. Housing and books are not included. Insurance is included only at Irvine.

Source: cmu.edu, reg.uci.edu, admission.ucla.edu, usmd.edu (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

At Wageningen, your speaking score counts too

WUR master's: IELTS overall 6.5, speaking at least 6.0; TOEFL iBT 90, speaking 22 (new scale 4.5 and 4.0). You must get the scores in a single test. The non-EU master's fee for 2027/28 is €22,560. Bachelor's requirements may differ.

Source: wur.nl (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

info.text:
“I can always apply to the Netherlands until 1 May”

The truth: Some institutions set an earlier non-EU date. Numerus fixus closes on 15 January. At Tilburg, Rotterdam UAS and Aeres, the deadline for non-EU applicants is 1 April. 1 May is only the general date.

Source: studyinnl.org, tilburguniversity.edu, rotterdamuas.com, aeresuas.com (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

info.text:
Plan backwards to start in September 2027

1. November-December 2026: UC applications close on 30 November. US regular applications: 1-5 January. For the UK, UCAS is 13 January 2027.
2. January-March 2027: Netherlands numerus fixus 15 January. Bocconi bachelor's Winter Session 26 January. RWTH master's 1 March.
3. April-June 2027: Netherlands non-EU dates fall between 1 April and 1 June. Germany winter semester: Dresden 31 May, HPI 1 June.
4. June-August 2027: Admission letters, proof of funds, visa appointment. You can get a US visa up to 365 days before classes start.
5. September 2027: Enrollment, orientation. In Italy, bachelor's and master's visa applications by 31 October 2027, enrollment by 31 January 2028.

These dates are examples. Your program's own page takes priority. Add 8 weeks for steps like the uni-assist document (VPD).

Source: admission.universityofcalifornia.edu, admissions.vanderbilt.edu, ucas.com, studyinnl.org, unibocconi.it, rwth-aachen.de, tilburguniversity.edu, hanze.nl, tu-dresden.de, hpi.de, travel.state.gov, unife.it, uni-assist.de (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Rietveld Academie does not accept TOEFL

For 2027/28, Rietveld accepts only IELTS Academic 6.0 (speaking 6.0); TOEFL is not valid. The foundation year portfolio is due 15 December 2026. Submit the IELTS certificate with your portfolio. Year 2 and 3 applications: 1 April 2027.
